currentTarget.text: Fungi tin'wana ti pfuna timitsu ku tswonga nutrients. Worm channels ti nga pfuna mati na moya ku nghena emhlabeni.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Put soil and water in a clear jar, with a little suitable dispersing detergent. Close and shake it, then leave it undisturbed.

currentTarget.text: Chela misava na mati eka clear jar, u chela nyana suitable dispersing detergent. Pfala jar u yi ninginika, kutani u yi tshika yi nga ninginiki.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Sand settles first. Silt settles next, while clay can remain suspended much longer.

currentTarget.text: Sand yi sungula ku tshamisa ehansi. Silt yi tshamisa endzhaku ka yona, kasi clay yi nga ha sala yi suspended much longer.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: This is a rough learning exercise. Clumps and unsettled clay can mislead you; use a soil laboratory when accurate texture is needed.

currentTarget.text: Lowu i rough learning exercise. Clumps na clay leyi nga si tshamaka ehansi swi nga ku hambukisa; tirhisa soil laboratory loko ku laveka accurate soil texture.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: A thick sand layer beneath cloudy water does not yet tell you the final proportions. Some fine particles may still be suspended.

currentTarget.text: Thick sand layer ehansi ka cloudy water a yi si komba final proportions. Fine particles tin’wana ti nga ha va suspended.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Compare the settled layers and feel the soil in the field.

currentTarget.text: Fananisa swiyenge leswi tshamaka ehansi, kutani u twa misava ensin'wini.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Record what you see and what remains uncertain. Do not prescribe watering or soil treatments from one jar alone.

currentTarget.text: Tsala leswi u swi vonaka ni leswi nga si tiyiseka. U nga teki xiboho xa ku cheleta kumbe ku tirhisa ndlela yo lulamisa misava hi ku ya hi jar yin’we ntsena.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Compaction, poor drainage and loss of organic matter can limit roots and soil life.

currentTarget.text: Compaction, poor drainage na ku lahleka ka organic matter can limit timitsu ni soil life.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Pale colour or few worms do not prove that chemicals killed the soil. Worm activity also changes with moisture and season.

currentTarget.text: Muhlovo lowu nga vonakaka wa pale kumbe few worms a swi tiyisisi leswaku chemicals ti dlayile misava. Worm activity na yona ya cinca hi ku ya hi moisture na season.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Look for patterns across the field. Check management history, drainage and plant growth before choosing a remedy.

currentTarget.text: Languta patterns leti humelelaka ensin'wini hinkwaro. Kambela management history, drainage ni ku kula ka swimilani u nga si hlawula remedy.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Compost is organic matter broken down under managed conditions.

currentTarget.text: Compost i organic matter leyi broken down ehansi ka managed conditions.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Finished compost can improve soil structure and contribute nutrients.

currentTarget.text: Finished compost yi nga antswisa xivumbeko xa misava ni ku contribute nutrients.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Time to readiness varies with materials, moisture, air and temperature. A province name or a fixed number of weeks is not a readiness test.

currentTarget.text: Nkarhi wo lungheka wa hambana hi materials, moisture, air na temperature. Vito ra province kumbe nhlayo leyi vekiweke ya mavhiki a hi readiness test.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Mix dry browns with fresh greens. Avoid thick, wet layers that keep air out.

currentTarget.text: Hlanganisa dry browns na fresh greens. Papalata thick, wet layers leti sivelaka air ku nghena.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: If the heap becomes slimy or smells strongly of ammonia, add dry browns and turn it.

currentTarget.text: Loko heap yi va slimy kumbe yi nun'hwa ammonia swinene, engetela dry browns kutani u yi turn.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Check moisture and air as the heap changes; one recipe does not suit every mix of materials.

currentTarget.text: Kambela moisture na air loko heap yi ri karhi yi cinca; recipe yin'we a yi ringani eka nkatsakanyo wun'wana ni wun'wana wa materials.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: A hot centre does not prove that every part of a heap has been treated. Time, temperature and management all matter.

currentTarget.text: Hot centre ya heap a yi tiyisisi leswaku every part ya heap yi treated. Time, temperature and management all matter.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Keep meat, dairy, diseased plants, pet waste and contaminated materials out of this simple household system.

currentTarget.text: Hlayisani meat, dairy, diseased plants, pet waste na contaminated materials swi ri ehandle ka simple household system.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Do not assume home composting destroys every weed seed or disease organism. Use a recognised process where sanitation is required.

currentTarget.text: U nga teki leswaku home composting yi lovisa weed seed yin'wana ni yin'wana kumbe disease organism yin'wana ni yin'wana. Tirhisa recognised process laha sanitation yi lavekaka.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Keep wattle seed pods out of the compost heap. An ordinary heap may not make every seed non-viable.

currentTarget.text: Hlayisani wattle seed pods ehandle ka compost heap. An ordinary heap may not make every seed non-viable.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Use only clean, untreated materials. Bark breaks down slowly; its name alone is not proof that it is free of contamination.

currentTarget.text: Tirhisa clean, untreated materials ntsena. Bark breaks down slowly; vito ra yona ntsena a hi vumbhoni bya leswaku a yi na contamination.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Check the heap and turn when it needs more air or mixing. Keep it moist rather than waterlogged.

currentTarget.text: Kambela heap kutani u yi turn loko yi lava air yo tala kumbe mixing. Yi hlayise yi ri moist, ku nga ri waterlogged.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Cover bare soil with suitable clean mulch, such as straw, dry grass or wood chips.

currentTarget.text: Funengetani misava leyi nga hava cover hi mulch leyi basekile, leyi faneleke, yo fana na straw, byanyi byo oma kumbe wood chips.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Keep it clear of trunks and stems. Check moisture underneath and adjust the layer; more mulch is not always better.

currentTarget.text: Keep it clear of trunks and stems. Kambelani moisture ehansi ka yona, mi lulamisa layer; mulch yo tala a yi vuli leswaku swi ta antswa nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Cover crops can protect ground between main crops. Choose for local weather, available water and the next planting.

currentTarget.text: Cover crops ti nga sirhelela misava leyi nga kona between main crops. Ti hlawuleni hi ku ya hi weather ya laha, mati lama kumekaka ni next planting.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: The course examples include oats, lupins, sunn hemp and cowpea. Check local suitability before sowing.

currentTarget.text: Swikombiso swa course swi katsa oats, lupins, sunn hemp na cowpea. Kambelani loko swi fanele ndhawu ya kwalaho mi nga si swi byala.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Legumes need suitable bacteria and growing conditions to fix nitrogen. Nutrients in their residues become available as the material decomposes.

currentTarget.text: Legumes ti lava bacteria leti faneleke ni suitable growing conditions leswaku ti fix nitrogen. Nutrients leti nga eka masalela ya tona ta kumeka loko material yi ri karhi yi bola.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Worm farms can turn suitable food scraps and bedding into castings. Check the bin rather than expecting a fixed harvest date.

currentTarget.text: Worm farms ti nga hundzuluxa food scraps ni bedding leswi faneleke swi va castings. Kambelani bin ematshan'weni yo langutela fixed harvest date.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin is called leachate. It is not the same as a prepared worm-casting tea.

currentTarget.text: Liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin yi vuriwa leachate. A yi fani na prepared worm-casting tea.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Leachate can contain harmful organisms or substances. Do not use it on edible plants or assume that dilution makes it safe.

currentTarget.text: Leachate yi nga va na harmful organisms kumbe substances. Do not use it on edible plants or assume that dilution makes it safe.
currentTarget.provenance: Complete current learner paragraph reused only for its byte-exact English source; unreviewed machine draft, no fluent/local farming approval.

targetFieldChanges.sourceEnglish: Start one soil-building action from this module.

currentTarget.text: Sungula goza rin'we ra soil-building ku suka eka modula lowu.
